en.headline: Government to hold Tiangong Classroom with Hong Kong astronaut soon
en.dek: Shenzhou-23 crew including first Hong Kong payload specialist Lai Ka-ying will give science demonstrations and hold a live dialogue with Hong Kong and Macao students.
body: A government spokesman announced on Saturday that a “Tiangong Classroom · Hong Kong-Macao Special Session” space education activity will be held in the near future.

The three-member Shenzhou-23 crew, including Hong Kong’s first payload specialist Lai Ka-ying, will conduct science experiment demonstrations from the Tiangong space station and engage in a live dialogue with participating students from Hong Kong and Macao. The Education Bureau will arrange for primary and secondary school teachers and students to watch the live broadcast in schools on the day.

The activity is jointly organised by the Hong Kong SAR Government, the Macao SAR Government and the China Manned Space Agency. It will include expert explanations, on-orbit demonstrations and a student question session, aimed at showing young people the special environment of space and space science and technology.

The event will be livestreamed on the Information Services Department website, the government news Facebook page and the “Together Realising the Aerospace Dream” thematic webpage. RTHK and other local television stations will also provide live coverage.

zh.headline: 政府近日舉辦天宮課堂 黎家盈等與港澳學生天地對話
zh.dek: 神舟二十三號乘組包括首位港產載荷專家黎家盈將在空間站進行科學實驗示範，並與港澳學生實時交流。
body: 政府發言人今日（5日）宣布，將於近日舉辦「天宮課堂·港澳專場」太空授課活動。
正在執行載人航天任務的神舟二十三號乘組三位航天員，包括香港首位載荷專家黎家盈，將在天宮空間站為參與活動的港澳學生進行科學實驗示範，並展開「天地對話」。教育局會安排各中小學師生當日於校內實時觀看直播。
活動由香港特別行政區政府、澳門特別行政區政府及中國載人航天工程辦公室共同主辦，內容包括專家講解、在軌演示及學生提問等環節，藉此向港澳青少年展示太空特殊環境與空間科學技術。
活動當日，政府新聞處網站、《政府新聞網》Facebook專頁以及「同圓航天夢 共襄復興業」主題宣傳專題網頁將會網上直播。香港電台及本地其他電視台亦會安排現場直播。
